task_instance: Given a described employee expense-reimbursement process (input written to current_process_input.md: 9 steps, 15-21 business day cycle time, manager/AP/controller handoffs, ~20% rework rate, ~5% data-entry error rate, ~120 reports/month), apply the skill's Map Current State / Identify Waste / Design Future State / Measure Impact framework and produce the required output: a before/after process comparison with specific improvement recommendations, estimated impact, and an implementation plan.
evidence: Created current_process_input.md describing a realistic 9-step current expense-reimbursement process with step owners, wait times, and known pain points. Produced process_optimization_report.md (80 lines) applying all four framework steps: (1) Current State Map as a table of every step/owner/time/type, (2) Waste Identified covering waiting, rework, handoffs, over-processing, and manual work each tied to specific evidence from the input, (3) Future State Design with 7 concrete redesign actions (eliminate Excel/email, automate ERP integration, reduce handoffs via conditional routing, risk-based approval threshold instead of flat $500 gate, SLA + auto-escalation, rolling payment runs) plus a future-state table, (4) Estimated Impact table quantifying cycle time (15-21 days -> 3-7 days), dual-approval rate (40% -> 10%), rework rate (20% -> <5%), AP manual effort (90 hrs/month -> 10 hrs/month), and error rate (5% -> <1%), and (5) a 5-phase Implementation Plan with owners and timeframes. Verified via `grep -n` that all five required sections exist in the file and via `wc -l`/`ls -la` that both files were written to the work directory (current_process_input.md 28 lines, process_optimization_report.md 80 lines). No blockers encountered: this skill's deliverable is a written analysis/document, fully producible with file read/write tools alone, no external services, credentials, or forbidden connectors needed.
